ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets fit my interest in polished singing and musical-theatre-style albums like Stages.
ItemID: NA; Title: Buon Natale: The Christmas Album; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Christmas repertoire appeals to me, but I would save it for holiday listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Man Against Machine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My listening to 747 and Golden makes another country album an appealing choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: How Can It Be; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not specifically looking for devotional music, and my recent listening gives me little reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: WOW Hits 2016; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A contemporary Christian compilation is less closely connected to what I want to hear right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The 50 Greatest Tracks; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or track list, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fifty Shades Of Grey: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Enjoying the Downton Abbey music does not make this soundtrack an obvious fit; I would want to hear samples first.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTX, Vol. III; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal harmonies interest me, but I would choose a more orchestral vocal album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nathan Pacheco; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: His classical-crossover singing closely matches my interest in Under One Sky, Amor & Pasion, and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down To My Last Bad Habit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country sound interests me, but I would sample it on a later visit after choosing another country album today.
